title: Comparing snack prices
observableEvidence: Computes and compares rates using a common unit.
prompt: A 6-pack of juice costs $4.20. A 10-pack costs $6.50. Which pack has the lower cost per bottle, and by how much per bottle? Enter the difference in dollars as a decimal, without the $ sign.
solutionMethod: Find each cost per bottle, compare the rates, and subtract the smaller rate from the larger one.

deterministicValidator.canonicalAnswer: Pack with the lower cost per bottle: 10-pack; Difference in cost per bottle: 0.05 dollars per bottle
acceptedAnswers: Pack with the lower cost per bottle: 10-pack; Difference in cost per bottle: 0.05 dollars per bottle
deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Structured fields: choose the pack and enter the per-bottle difference in dollars as a decimal. Both must be correct; no partial credit. Replaces the content-2 substring parts validator (TR-7).

fields.label: Pack with the lower cost per bottle

hintSteps.prompt: Total price alone is not a fair comparison when pack sizes differ.

What do the two quotients represent?

hintSteps.prompt: Compare rates with the same unit, then find their difference.

accessibilityNotes: Use text labels alongside currency symbols in the prompt; the pack choice is a labelled radio group and the difference is a labelled number field stating its unit. No color coding is needed.
